diagnostics.title: Instance diagnostics
diagnostics.subtitle: Checks the proxy, public address, database and storage.

summary.ok: All good: the instance is set up correctly.
summary.warning: It works, but something needs fixing.
summary.error: Something is not working: follow the hints below.

browser_origin.title: Address in the browser
browser_origin.fix: Open Inkadra from the address set in PUBLIC_URL, or fix PUBLIC_URL.

websocket.title: Real-time collaboration (WebSocket)
websocket.fix: The proxy must forward WebSocket requests on /collab, with the Upgrade and Connection headers.

public_url_https.title: PUBLIC_URL uses HTTPS
public_url_https.fix: Outside localhost use an https:// address: sign-in cookies are only secure over HTTPS.

public_url_matches_request.title: The server sees the public address
public_url_matches_request.fix: The proxy must send X-Forwarded-Proto and Host, and TRUST_PROXY must include the proxy’s address.

proxy_trusted.title: Proxy trusted
proxy_trusted.fix: Add the address the proxy connects from (the peer address) to TRUST_PROXY.

database.title: Database
database.fix: Check DATABASE_URL and that Postgres is running.

queue.title: Job queue (Valkey)
queue.fix: Check REDIS_URL and that Valkey is running.

data_dir_writable.title: Data folder writable
data_dir_writable.fix: DATA_DIR must be writable by the container user (uid 1000).

storage.title: File storage
storage.fix: Check the storage settings: local folder or S3 bucket, credentials and permissions.

errors.admin: Only administrators can see the diagnostics. Sign in with an administrator account.
errors.rateLimited: Too many checks: wait a minute.
errors.generic: The checks could not run. Try again.

settings.title: Account
settings.lead: Your profile, how you sign in and the apps you connected.

methods.title: Sign-in methods
methods.body: Connect Google or your studio’s provider to sign in without a password.
methods.last: It is the only way you sign in: add another one first.

password.title: Password
password.body: Changing it signs out your other sessions.
password.changed: Password changed. Your other sessions were signed out.

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.on: On: signing in also asks for a code from your app.
twoFactor.off: Add a code from an authenticator app (1Password, Google Authenticator, Aegis…).
twoFactor.needsPassword: Your account needs a password for this. If you sign in with Google or your studio’s provider, two-step verification is handled there.
twoFactor.scan: Scan the code with your authenticator app, then type the 6-digit code.
twoFactor.backup: Keep these backup codes somewhere safe: each one lets you in once if you lose your phone.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.body: The devices you are signed in on.
sessions.endOthers: Sign out of all other devices

tokens.title: Apps and tokens
tokens.body: The clipper, the mobile app and scripts sign in with a personal token. Revoke it if you lose a device.
tokens.name: Token name
tokens.copyNow: Token “{{name}}” created. Copy it now: you won’t see it again.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.body: Deletes the account and the projects nobody else is in. This cannot be undone.
delete.confirmBody: Projects where you are alone are deleted with all their files. In shared projects the work stays, without you.
delete.fresh: For safety, you must have signed in during the last 15 minutes: sign out and back in if needed.
delete.blocked: You are the only owner of these shared projects: make someone else owner first.
